work_completed: AGENT-LOOP-002 T6 acceptance 4 rerun on the dev PC with Fusion#126 and #111 (world engine a728fd7, Fusion 9aa44e9 in a temporary sparse worktree, Qwen3-0.6B-Q8_0 on CPU, port 8011). Plaza and roads draped on the terrain (Joshua's choice over colliders plus step-up). TerrainBuilder.SurfaceHeightAt is the terrain mesh's own surface (what the trimesh body is); TerrainBuilder.Segments is the shared grid size. SettlementBuilder.PlazaPaving / RoadPaving build the paving 4 cm / 3 cm above that surface; the raised plaza disc and the flat road boxes are gone. The well stands on the ground; benches are a seat on two legs (they sat flush in the old deck).

Tree trunk bodies (Joshua): one Collision_Trees static body with a cylinder per trunk (620), at the trunk's base radius from the ground to its visual top (VegetationBuilder.ColliderFor, sized to Joshua's spec). Rocks, canopies and grass stay walk-through.
AgentHarness: new [ground: paving and tree trunks] section, 13 checks.

Avatar stuck at a tree (Joshua's run, after trunks became solid). It stopped at (-64.38, -19.37) about 20 s before Fusion's first intent. Fixed head-on stalls: LocomotionController.AroundObstacle, called from AgentBrain with last tick's wall normal, turns a heading pressing into an obstacle within ~32 degrees of head-on along it, keeping one side while blocked. Fixed why it was there: AvatarCharacter.Anchors now reaches the spawn UtilityAgentController (Main sets anchors after _Ready, so it marched its 'quiet' bearing due south). Fixed the tour parking on the anchor it had just reached (UtilityAgentController now moves on to another while one is free). Harness 139/139 (10 detour, 3 tour checks).
blockers: AGENT-LOOP-002 T6 acceptance 4 is blocked on a Fusion-side goal or policy (the model has no reason to prefer sit or use) and on Joshua's call about wait when nothing is in perception range.

decisions_pending: AGENT-LOOP-002: what wait should do when nothing is in perception range (resume wandering only then; spawn or perceive so a door is always in range; or accept it).

The fallback tour picks the nearest anchor other than the one just reached, so from the plaza it alternates plaza <-> well. A richer route (least recently visited, or including doors) is Joshua's call.
